words_to_learn.definition_en: to gain possession of; to get by one's own efforts
words_to_learn.definition_vi: mua được, giành được, tiếp thu (kỹ năng)

extra_families.example: The national gallery hopes to acquire several rare Renaissance drawings.

srs_sentence.en: The museum's newest _____, a seventeenth-century oil portrait, will be unveiled on Friday.
srs_sentence.vi: Tác phẩm mới nhất mà bảo tàng mua được, một bức chân dung sơn dầu thế kỷ 17, sẽ được ra mắt vào thứ Sáu.

words_to_learn.definition_en: to regard with pleasure; to have esteem or respect for
words_to_learn.definition_vi: chiêm ngưỡng, ngưỡng mộ, khâm phục

examples.en: Raisa, admiring the famous smile, stood before the Mona Lisa for hours.
examples.vi: Raisa, vừa chiêm ngưỡng nụ cười nổi tiếng, vừa đứng trước bức tranh Mona Lisa suốt nhiều giờ.

examples.en: I admire all the effort the museum put into organizing this wonderful exhibit.
examples.vi: Tôi ngưỡng mộ tất cả những nỗ lực mà bảo tàng đã bỏ ra để tổ chức cuộc triển lãm tuyệt vời này.

word_family.example: People from all around the world visit the museum to admire the great works of art on display.
I have great admiration for anyone who can create art.

extra_families.example: Hundreds of admirers gathered at the gallery opening to meet the painter.

srs_sentence.en: Visitors from around the world expressed great _____ for the intricately carved marble statues.
srs_sentence.vi: Du khách từ khắp nơi trên thế giới bày tỏ sự ngưỡng mộ lớn đối với những bức tượng đá cẩm thạch được chạm khắc tinh xảo.

words_to_learn.definition_en: a group of objects or works to be seen, studied, or kept together
words_to_learn.definition_vi: bộ sưu tập; sự thu thập, sự quyên góp

examples.en: The museum's collection contained many works donated by famous collectors.
examples.vi: Bộ sưu tập của bảo tàng chứa nhiều tác phẩm được hiến tặng bởi những nhà sưu tầm nổi tiếng.

examples.en: The museum's collection kept two full-time curators busy.
examples.vi: Bộ sưu tập của bảo tàng khiến hai giám tuyển toàn thời gian luôn bận rộn.

word_family.example: The enthusiast began to collect Shaker furniture in the 1960s.

structures: on loan from a private collection
usage.tip: Cụm 'permanent collection' (bộ sưu tập trưng bày thường xuyên của bảo tàng) rất phổ biến trong các bài đọc về bảo tàng/triển lãm.

extra_families.example: Organizing the retrospective exhibition required a collective effort from the entire staff.

srs_sentence.en: Several rare ceramics in the exhibit were generously loaned by a private art _____.
srs_sentence.vi: Một số đồ gốm quý hiếm trong triển lãm đã được một nhà sưu tầm nghệ thuật tư nhân hào phóng cho mượn.

words_to_learn.definition_en: an evaluation, especially of literary or other artistic works
words_to_learn.definition_vi: sự phê bình, lời chỉ trích, bình phẩm nghệ thuật

examples.en: According to the criticism of the Victorian era, the painting was a masterpiece; now it is considered merely a minor work.

extra_families.example: The exhibition was a critical success and attracted record crowds.

The City Art Museum, Museum of History, National University Museum of Scientific Research, and the Hall of Presidents are among the most popular destinations for museumgoers. The National Transportation Museum, currently undergoing renovations, is scheduled to reopen next year with a larger number of exhibits and extended hours. Visitors to the City Art Museum can admire the collection of paintings by local artists as well as famous art works from around the world. The museum’s collection covers a wide spectrum of artists and styles, and critics have called it one of the most significant in the world. # Museums

Study the following definitions and examples.

1. acquire v., to gain possession of; to get by one's own efforts a. The museum acquired a van Gogh during heavy bidding.

b. The sculptor acquired metalworking skills after much practice.

2. admire v., to regard with pleasure; to have esteem or respect for

a. Raisa, admiring the famous smile, stood before the Mona Lisa for hours.

b. I admire all the effort the museum put into organizing this wonderful exhibit.

3. collection n., a group of objects or works to be seen, studied, or kept together

a. The museum's collection contained many works donated by famous collectors.

b. The museum's collection kept two full-time curators busy.

4. criticism n., an evaluation, especially of literary or other artistic works a. According to the criticism of the Victorian era, the painting was a masterpiece; now it is considered merely a minor work.

b. The revered artist's criticism of the piece was particularly insightful.

5. express v., to give an opinion or depict emotion a. The sculptor was able to express his feelings better through the use of clay rather than words.

b. The photograph expresses a range of emotions.

6. fashion n., the prevailing style or custom

a. According to the fashion of the day, the languid pose of the sculpture was high art.

b. The museum's classical architecture has never gone out of fashion.

7. leisure n., freedom from time-consuming duties; free time a. The woman took up painting in her retirement, when she had more leisure time.

b. We can go to the permanent collection at our leisure.

8. respond v., to make a reply; to react

a. You should respond to the invitation to attend the museum gala.

b. The visitors who viewed those poignant photographs responded emotionally.
